title: sarcostemma viminale subsp. brunonianum
intro: Sarcostemma viminale subsp. brunonianum, commonly known as the "Thorny Caltrops" or "Bhui Amla" in Ayurvedic medicine, is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, diarrhea, and skin disorders, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-cancer and anti-diabetic activities, and act as an anthelmintic agent. The bioactive constituents of Sarcostemma viminale subsp. brunonianum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
